distinguishing_fact: Model 225B is composed of brass (61% copper, 35% zinc, 4% other material) without precious metal plating or coating, whereas 7419.80.30 requires the copper article to be coated or plated with precious metal.
reasoning: Model 225B is a brass snap hook composed of 61% copper, 35% zinc, and 4% other material. Under Note 5 to Section XV, an alloy of base metals is classified as an alloy of the metal which predominates by weight over each of the other metals; thus, it is treated as a copper alloy under Note 1(b) to Chapter 74. Heading 8308 is excluded per EN 83.08 and HQ 954696 because snap hooks with spring catches and swivels possess mechanical fastening functionality beyond simple hooks. Explanatory Notes to heading 74.19 cover copper articles corresponding to heading 73.26 (which explicitly includes snap hooks). Following the 2022 HTS revision replacing 7419.99 with 7419.80, the article is not wire cloth, springs, chain, or coated/plated with precious metal, classifying under 8-digit subheading 7419.80.50.

citations.quote: Copper alloys: Metallic substances other than unrefined copper in which copper predominates by weight over each of the other elements

distinguishing_fact: Subheading 3822.90 covers certified reference materials accompanied by a certificate indicating certified property values and measurement uncertainty pursuant to Note 2(a) to Chapter 38, whereas the merchandise consists of disposable diagnostic reagents on a backing for blood glucose testing classified under 3822.19.00.
reasoning: The merchandise consists of CareSens N and other blood glucose test strips. These items are composed of layers containing chemical reagent mixtures on a backing designed to measure glucose concentration in whole blood via an electrochemical reaction in conjunction with a blood glucose meter. By application of GRI 1, the goods fall under heading 3822 as diagnostic reagents on a backing. Within heading 3822, subheadings 3822.11 through 3822.13 cover diagnostic reagents for malaria, Zika/Aedes-borne diseases, and blood grouping, none of which apply. Subheading 3822.90 covers certified reference materials under Note 2(a) to Chapter 38. Therefore, the goods fall under subheading 3822.19.00 (and statistical reporting number 3822.19.0080 because the reagent does not contain antigens, antisera, methyl chloroform, or carbon tetrachloride).

citations.quote: Diagnostic or laboratory reagents on a backing, prepared diagnostic or laboratory reagents whether or not on a backing, whether or not put up in the form of kits: Other

For the purposes of heading 3822, the expression "certified reference materials" means reference materials which are accompanied by a certificate which indicates the values of the certified properties, the methods used to determine these values and the degree of certainty associated with each value and which are suitable for analytical, calibrating or referencing purposes.
